_meta.name: Billion-dollar disasters
_meta.source: computed from NOAA NCEI billion-dollar disaster individual event records
_meta.note: Computed from individual event records (name, dates, CPI-adjusted cost); annual count and annual cost, summed by event begin-year. Costs converted from millions to billions of dollars, CPI-adjusted as NOAA published them in the archived final edition (the file does not name the dollar base year); 1980–2024 only. Product retired in 2025; record ends in 2024. No successor data appended.
_meta.breaks: Product retired in 2025; record ends in 2024. No successor data appended.
_meta.annualRule: Annual event count and CPI-adjusted cost summed by event begin-year.
